title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN, November 3 - Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, Speaker of Iran’s Parliament made statements at today's session.
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN, November 3 - Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, Speaker of Iran’s Parliament made statements at today's session."

""
"———-"

"SOT1, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, Speaker of Iran’s Parliament (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:47): “The countries of the region should know that the Islamic Republic of Iran, just as it stands with its finger on the trigger ready for the battle, has given a powerful and rational response to the American side, and now the ball is in America's court to prevent war. At the same time, we are at the highest level of readiness and defense in both the field and military arenas; if Washington commits another strategic mistake, it should know that this time it will face a new battlefield and will be seeking an escape route even more desperate than today.""

"SOT2, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, Speaker of Iran’s Parliament (Farsi) (00:48 - 01:35): “Americans and their allies have realized from the logical defeat of their forces in the two recent imposed wars that the era of excess has come to an end. The Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces [Iran's Supreme leader] has specified our military strategy in confronting a potential enemy attack. Accordingly, our military and strategic response to any miscalculation by the enemy will be unpredictable, in such a way that, without adhering to geographical limitations, we will roll up their erroneous calculations along with all their material and immaterial assets.""

"SOT3, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, Speaker of Iran’s Parliament (Farsi) (01:36 - 02:09): “The root of America's deep-rooted hostility toward the Iranian nation is also this very issue: that our nation has stood against this greedy objective and has turned its independence-seeking spirit into an aspiration for other free nations of the world. This very steadfastness and resistance of the people has driven the usurping Zionist regime and the Americans to desperation, and they do not know what to do with the resilient nation of Iran.""

"SOT4, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, Speaker of Iran’s Parliament (Farsi) (02:10 - 02:35): “Faced with their series of defeats, they occasionally attempt to force the Iranian nation to surrender through threats and military action, but they are gravely mistaken; Iran will not surrender, and this pipe dream of the enemy belongs to the era of past puppet and dependent regimes.
